meta.name: kubernetes-specialist
meta.description: Use when deploying or managing Kubernetes workloads. Invoke to create deployment manifests, configure pod security policies, set up service accounts, define network isolation rules, debug pod crashes, analyze resource limits, inspect container logs, or right-size workloads. Use for Helm charts, RBAC policies, NetworkPolicies, storage configuration, performance optimization, GitOps pipelines, and multi-cluster management.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 部署和管理 Kubernetes 工作负载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Kubernetes 集群或部署容器化应用。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Kubernetes clusters or deploy containerized applications.

howto.what: 它会按 Kubernetes 规范生成部署文件(YAML),自动包含资源用量上限、健康检查、安全设置等,并附上权限与网络隔离配置和设计说明。
howto.when: 当你提到“Kubernetes”“kubectl”“Helm”等关键词,或要求部署、管理、排查 Kubernetes 工作负载时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Deployment 的 YAML,带资源限制和健康检查。
say.note: 会生成符合规范的部署清单。

say.text: 给这个服务加上 NetworkPolicy,只允许前端访问。
检查我的 Pod 为什么崩溃,并给出修复建议。
say.note: 会用 kubectl 命令定位问题并输出修复后的配置。

howto.what_en: Generates Kubernetes YAML manifests with resource limits, liveness/readiness probes, security context, RBAC roles, and NetworkPolicies, plus design rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Kubernetes-related terms like "Kubernetes", "kubectl", "Helm", or asks to deploy, manage, or troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads.

say_en.text: Write a Deployment YAML with resource limits and health checks.
Add a NetworkPolicy for this service, allowing only frontend.
Debug my crashing Pod and suggest a fix.
say_en.note: Uses kubectl to diagnose and outputs corrected config.
